morphology.pattern_note: 按英语整词处理，不作马来语词缀拆分。/θ/ 是英语清齿擦音；这里的 IPA 是英式英语读音，并非经核实的标准马来语读音。未确认马来语派生词族，因此 word_family 留空。

senses.zh_definition: 英语建筑用语：由回廊围合的露天庭院；古义亦指围合的院地或园地。
senses.en_definition: An open courtyard enclosed by cloisters; archaically, an enclosed yard or garden.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, halaman terbuka yang dikelilingi serambi berangkai; dalam penggunaan lama, halaman atau kebun berpagar.
senses.nuances: 未核实 garth 为规范马来语词，不能将其标为 official。此处提供英语义以辅助辨认，马来文释义为编辑翻译，不是 DBP 官方释义。搭配采用马来文讨论外语词的结构，不冒充高频马来语搭配。[Collins 英语词条](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/garth)

collocations.en: the meaning of the word garth

senses.zh_definition: 英格兰北部方言：儿童滚玩的圆环，常以自行车轮圈制成。
senses.en_definition: In northern English dialect, a child's hoop, often a bicycle-wheel rim.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam dialek utara England, gelung permainan kanak-kanak, yang sering berupa rim roda basikal.
senses.nuances: 这是英语方言的另一同形词，不是已核实的马来语义项。以下均为说明性语言讨论组合。大写 Garth 另可作人名；没有原始语境，不能确定输入记录具体指哪一种。[Collins 方言义及专名记录](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/garth)

collocations.zh: 英格兰北部方言中的 garth

etymology.historical_story: English garth is recorded from the fourteenth century and comes from Old Norse garðr, an enclosure or yard. It is related to English yard and survives particularly in descriptions of cloister courtyards. The northern dialect word for a hoop has a separate explanation as a variant of girth. Neither history establishes Malay adoption. [Collins etymologies](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/garth)
